data: Which of the following best describes the overall shape of the red line in Plot (a)?

The red line in Plot (a) represents the average length of a thread 〈L〉 versus the absolute emotional value in the first 10 comments |〈e〉10|. The overall shape of the red line appears to be somewhat irregular, with several peaks and troughs. It starts at approximately 88, rises sharply to around 94 at an absolute emotional content of about 0.2, then drops back down to around 88. It then shows some fluctuations, with another peak near 90 at an absolute emotional content of about 0.6 and another peak near 91 at an absolute emotional content of about 0.9. Finally, it drops back down to around 87. Overall, the red line has a somewhat jagged appearance, with no clear trend or pattern.
